awarding_body.detail: The page is Umeå University's own site (umu.se, university branding) and the scholarship is described as offered by the university itself. It matches the recorded awarding body 'Umeå University'.
awarding_body.quote: Umeå University offers scholarships to talented and high-achieving students from outside the EU/EEA.

deadline.detail: The page quotes exactly the recorded deadline wording '4 March (23:59 CET): Deadline to register interest for a scholarship', but only inside its 'Timeline for 2026' block, and that cycle is closed (today is 12 October 2026). No dates for the next cycle have been published: the scholarships page was last updated 2025-12-18 and still shows 2026 dates, while the university's key-dates page (updated 2026-08-23) shows the Autumn 2027 application round opening 16 October 2026 — four days from now. So the page shows a past deadline and no deadline for a currently-open cycle; per the brief the record is not verifiable as open.
deadline.quote: 4 March (23:59 CET): Deadline to register interest for a scholarship

eligibility.detail: Every recorded eligibility claim is confirmed verbatim, including the second-year master's / current-student route: citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland, a completed application for a full Umeå bachelor's or master's programme by 15 January 2026, the application fee paid by 2 February 2026 (fee-exempt students who pay tuition also eligible), a Umeå programme as priority 1 on University Admissions by 15 January 2026, and current students who have paid the Spring 2026 tuition fee and are registered for that semester (study-leave students excluded). The page adds one exclusion not in the record: the Master's Programme in Sustainability Reporting and Financial Analysis is ineligible because it is a double degree.
eligibility.quote: are a citizen of a country outside of the EU/EEA and Switzerland; have applied for a full programme at Umeå University* (Bachelor's or Master's); have completed your application for programme studies before the application deadline on 15 January 2026; have paid the application fee by 2 February 2026**; and have chosen a Umeå University programme as priority 1 on the University Admissions website by 15 January 2026 at the latest.

funding.detail: The award is a tuition-fee waiver only, full or partial — it matches the recorded 'Tuition Fee Waiver' and is not fully funded. The FAQ confirms Umeå University offers no other financial support.
funding.quote: Scholarships are offered in the form of tuition-waivers. Selected candidates receive a full or partial waiver of the tuition fee.

degree_levels.detail: The page states the scholarship applies to applicants for a full bachelor's or master's programme at Umeå University, matching the recorded degree levels (Bachelor's, Master's).
degree_levels.quote: have applied for a full programme at Umeå University* (Bachelor's or Master's)
